description.value:
You invoke an ancient wraith to appear and fight by your side. This specter may be the spirit of some long-dead king or warlord. It occupies the space of a Medium creature and has a fly Speed of 40 feet.

Arrive (mental, visual) Kneel, Peons! The specter raises its hand, indicating that all foes should pay it obeisance. All enemies within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:60] of the specter must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature kneels, dropping @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Prone] as a free action.

Failure As success, and the creature can't Stand for the duration of the spell.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature also bows its head, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Dazzled] for the duration of the spell.

Depart (auditory, emotion, mental) Listen and Weep The specter speaks, and though its words have no meaning, they convey a terrible tragedy. All living enemies that have both eyes and blood (or a reasonable equivalent) within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] begin to weep tears of blood. They take @Damage[4d6[persistent,bleed]|options:area-damage] damage with a basic Fortitude save. On a failure, a creature is also dazzled for as long as they take the persistent bleed damage.

duration.value: until the end of your next turn
